LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingAmbushChoice: Choose how to meet an ambush

On by default. When a convoy of your vehicles is ambushed while it drives, the game stops and you choose: stop and fight (as the game does), drive through, or turn back. A way out is a chance, shown on each choice, that rises with the convoy's speed and its vehicles' armour; if it fails, the ambush goes ahead. A convoy that turns back waits 4 hours. Off: convoys always fight, as in the game.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingTrailerFault: On by default. A vehicle towing a trailer whose running gear has a wrecked part keeps only a quarter of its speed, and the trailer's damaged running gear wears further while it is dragged. You are warned either way. Off: wrecked trailers are towed at full speed, as before.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingTestHoleInse: Off by default. On: a drill rig's test hole on the road can break into insect tunnels, by the game's own deep drill rule, and the convoy must fight them. On, a test hole brings up 4 portions; off, 3. Your people can die, so it starts off.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_JobHeldUp: {CARAVAN}'s work at the halt is held up: {REASON}
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_Busy: {VEHICLE} is busy with other work at this halt.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_InspectJobHeldUp: The work at the halt is held up: {REASON}
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_SurveyGizmoDesc: While the convoy drives, someone aboard who is not driving reads the long-range console, and now and then finds a lump of {ORE} near the way the convoy went. Someone with Intellectual skill must ride along; the better their skill, the sooner a find.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_SurveyNoKit: {VEHICLE} has no long-range kit to survey from the road.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_SurveyNoHand: Nobody but the drivers aboard can read {VEHICLE}'s console: the survey waits.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_InspectSurvey: {VEHICLE} surveys the ground on the way, for {ORE}.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_SurveyHaltGizmoDesc: Stop here for about {HOURS} hours of work at the console, by day, and read the ground under the convoy: which ore lies deep here and roughly how much, and, where water has a use, what a water bore would give. A tile reads the same every time, so it is read once. A drill rig can then prove the find with a test hole. Someone with Intellectual skill must do it; the convoy must stay put.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_SurveyHaltStopGizmoDesc: Stop reading the ground. Nothing is learnt until the reading is finished.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_SurveyHaltNoHand: Nobody in the convoy is fit to read the console: it needs someone able in Intellectual work.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_SurveyHaltStarted: {VEHICLE} stops to read the ground here: about {HOURS} hours at the console.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_SurveyHaltStopped: The survey halt is stopped before the reading was finished.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_SurveyHaltLeft: {CARAVAN} drove on before the ground was read.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_ReadingOre: About {UNITS} {ORE} lies deep under the ground.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_ReadingNoOre: No deep ore worth drilling for lies under the ground.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_ReadingNoBedrock: There is no bedrock here to hold deep ore.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_ReadingWater: A water bore would give about {LITRES} litres an hour.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_ReadingDry: A water bore would come up dry.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TestHoleGizmoDesc: Prove the ore the survey halt read here: about {HOURS} hours of drilling by day, bringing up a few portions into the convoy's cargo, the tipper's hold first. It needs someone able in Mining, burns the rig's fuel and wears its drill bit. A tile takes one test hole. The convoy must stay put.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TestHoleInsectsDesc: Deep drilling can break into insect tunnels, as the game's deep drills do.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TestHoleStopGizmoDesc: Stop drilling. Nothing comes up until the hole is finished.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TestHoleNotRead: The ground here has not been read: a survey halt comes first.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TestHoleNoOre: The reading found no deep ore here to prove.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TestHolePiped: The {ORE} here only comes up through a well head, not a test hole.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TestHoleStarted: {VEHICLE} starts a test hole: about {HOURS} hours of drilling.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TestHoleDone: {CARAVAN}'s test hole proved the find: {AMOUNT} brought up.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TestHoleStopped: The test hole is stopped before it was finished.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TestHoleLeft: {CARAVAN} drove on and left its test hole unfinished.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TestHoleInsectsText: {VEHICLE}'s test hole broke into an insect tunnel. They are coming up out of the ground, and the convoy has to fight.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreGizmoDesc: Drill a bore here and pump the ground water into the convoy's water tanks. {RAIN} mm of rain falls here a year, so the bore would give about {LITRES} litres an hour once drilled. The water is untreated, as from a river. Drilling takes hours of work by someone with Mining skill, stops at night, burns the rig's fuel and wears its drill bit. The convoy must stay put.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreStopGizmoDesc: Stop drilling or pumping. The water already pumped stays in the tanks.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreNoWater: Nothing here gives water a use.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreMoving: The convoy must stop for this.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreDry: The ground here is dry: {RAIN} mm of rain a year, under the {LINE} mm a bore needs.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreNoHand: Nobody in the convoy is fit to drill: it needs someone able in Mining.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreTanksFull: The convoy's water tanks are full, or it carries none set to water.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreStarted: {VEHICLE} starts drilling a water bore; once drilled it should give about {LITRES} litres an hour.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreDrilled: {CARAVAN}'s bore has reached water and is pumping.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreFull: {CARAVAN}'s water tanks are full from the bore: {LITRES} litres.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreStopped: The bore is stopped after {LITRES} litres.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_BoreLeft: {CARAVAN} drove on and left its bore after {LITRES} litres.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_InspectDrilling: Drilling a water bore: {SHARE} of the way down.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_InspectPumping: Pumping from the bore: {LITRES} litres an hour, {PUMPED} litres so far.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_TipGizmoDesc: Tip everything {VEHICLE} carries into a depot on this tile, making one if there is none, to lighten the convoy for a climb or leave a stock for the way back. The depot window takes it back out. The convoy must stop.
LanguageData.PhobosRoadWork_Tipped: {VEHICLE} tipped its load into the depot here: {COUNT} things.
LanguageData.PhobosAmbush_Text: {CONVOY} has spotted an ambush ahead: {WHO} lying in wait by the way. There is a moment to choose: stop and fight, put the foot down and try to drive through, or turn round and fall back.\n\nThe odds of a way out rise with the convoy's speed and the armour on its vehicles. If a way out fails, the ambush goes ahead.
LanguageData.PhobosAmbush_TurnBack: Turn back ({CHANCE} to get away; the convoy stops and waits {HOURS} hours for the road to clear)
LanguageData.PhobosAmbush_Stuck: {VEHICLE} cannot move: there is no way out but to fight.
LanguageData.PhobosAmbush_Caught: {CONVOY} could not get away: the ambush is sprung.
LanguageData.PhobosAmbush_DroveThrough: {CONVOY} drove through the ambush and got past.
LanguageData.PhobosAmbush_TurnedBack: {CONVOY} turned back from the ambush and got away. It waits {HOURS} hours for the road to clear.
LanguageData.PhobosAmbush_InspectHeld: Waiting for the road to clear after turning back from an ambush: {TIME} more.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailerFault_CouplingWarning: {TRAILER}'s {PART} is wrecked: it can be towed, but only dragged at a crawl ({SHARE} of the speed), and its running gear will wear further. Repair it first if you can.
LanguageData.PhobosTrailerFault_Wrecked: {TRAILER}, behind {VEHICLE}, is on a wrecked {PART}. It is being dragged at a crawl. Repair it, carry on slowly, or leave it at a depot.
